qa.asked:
I've rebuilt the site so it works on phones and looks more current, and committed it (`407db1b`). I checked it in headless Chromium screenshots at 390px and 1200px wide. I didn't test the mobile menu or the form by hand, and I haven't looked at the lower sections (membership, join, news, contact) in the screenshots.

**Phones**
- The page was a fixed 980px wide with no viewport tag, so phones showed a tiny zoomed-out page. It now fits any screen width.
- The nav collapses into a "Menu" button, and the header stays at the top while scrolling.
- The 6-column timetable becomes one card per session on phones. It's still a normal table on larger screens.
- Membership plans reflow into a grid.
- The join form has proper labels, email and phone keyboards, and autofill. Fields are full-width and big enough to tap, and the 16px input text stops iOS zooming in. Errors now show inline instead of in pop-up alerts.

**Look**
- The text was small, light grey and Verdana. It's now a larger system font with darker, easier-to-read colours, and the navy and gold branding is kept.
- The notices ticker now pauses on hover and stops moving for anyone with reduced motion turned on.

**Things I didn't change that you should look at**
- **The join form doesn't send anywhere.** It only shows a "Thanks" message in the browser, and the entered details are discarded, as before. Members who "join" never reach the club, so it needs a form service or a mailto/backend. I can wire one up if you tell me what you use.
- **The content is out of date.** The news items and footer say 2013, and the ticker mentions "6th May" and "entries by 20th April". Someone at the club needs to refresh these.
qa.answer: Thanks, that sounds good. Please go ahead with the form: we don't have a form service, so a mailto or simple option that keeps the site plain HTML is fine. Your call on which. We'll get someone at the club to update the news, footer and ticker dates.

qa.asked:
The join form now opens the visitor's email app with a pre-filled message to `info@harbourswimclub.co.uk`. I committed it as `9abaeef`. I checked that the script parses, but I haven't run the form in a browser or opened a real email draft.

- **What the email contains:** The subject is "Membership enquiry: <type>". The body has their name, email, phone and membership type, plus a line saying they agreed to be contacted.
- **What the member sees:** The thank-you message says their email app should open and they need to press Send. It doesn't promise a reply within two days, because nothing reaches the club until they send it. It also has a "Try again" link and the club's email address and phone number as a fallback.
- **Limits of `mailto:`:**
  - Some people, especially on a computer with no email app set up, will see nothing happen. The fallback text covers them, but a few may drop off.
  - Some people will never press Send.
  - The club won't see anyone who doesn't send.
  - If the club later gets a form service, the form is ready to switch over.
- **Recipient address:** I used the general `info@` address from the contact section. If you'd rather the emails go to Helen Carne, the membership secretary, change the `CLUB_EMAIL` line at the top of the join form code in `script.js`. I don't have her direct address.

I haven't touched the news items, footer or ticker dates, as you asked.
qa.answer: Thanks, that works for us. The email-app approach is fine, and the fallback with the address and phone number is a good idea. Please send the emails to info@ for now. We don't have a form service, so we'll stay with this.
